=== indent after colon
--- before
def f():¦
--- keys
<enter>pass
--- after
def f():
    pass¦

=== indent after if
--- before
if x:¦
--- keys
<enter>
--- after
if x:
    ¦

=== dedent after return
--- before
def f():
    return 1¦
--- keys
<enter>
--- after
def f():
    return 1
¦

=== dedent after pass
--- before
class A:
    pass¦
--- keys
<enter>
--- after
class A:
    pass
¦

=== open bracket continues
--- before
x = [¦]
--- keys
<enter>
--- after
x = [
    ¦
]

=== autoclose paren
--- before
print¦
--- keys
("hi
--- after
print("hi¦")

=== no autoclose in comment
--- before
# see ¦
--- keys
(
--- after
# see (¦

=== string prefix quote
--- before
x = f¦
--- keys
"a
--- after
x = f"a¦

=== line comment
--- before
«a = 1
b = 2»
--- keys
<lc>
--- after
«# a = 1
# b = 2»

=== surround
--- before
x = «a»
--- keys
'
--- after
x = '«a»'

=== else dedents
--- before
if x:
    a
    ¦
--- keys
else:
--- after
if x:
    a
else:¦
